Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend up to 3 Digimon. For each of your opponent's Digimon this effect suspended, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and gets +3000 DP.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
